notes: ETC Element 2 is a theatrical/architectural lighting control console (Eos Family), not a conventional AV device, so the closest-fit category/type in the provided enums ("control" / "Control processor") is an approximation. Desktop console, not rack-mountable (rackUnits omitted); dimensions 868x362x111mm, 7.26kg. Data drawn from ETC's own Tech Specs page (etcconnect.com) and cross-checked against ETC's official "Element 2" datasheet PDF (Rev B, 2022-01, hosted at media.musson.com and fullcompass.com — identical manufacturer-authored content) plus ETC's Eos Family Online Help page for the Element 2 (Littlite pinout) and community pinout data for the Remote Trigger D-Sub. Ships with (not listed as ports): 2x active DisplayPort-to-DVI adapters, USB keyboard, mouse. Also present but not physical wired I/O so omitted from ports: 802.11ac WiFi adapter and Bluetooth 5.1 (wireless, "to be enabled with future software"), and a Kensington lock slot (mechanical, not a signal/power connector). ETC's spec sheet explicitly states MIDI, SMPTE timecode, and Analog/Serial I/O are available "through network interface or Response Gateways" — i.e. via external accessory hardware or over Ethernet/OSC, not via dedicated physical ports on the Element 2 console itself — so none of those were listed as ports. USB port total (5x USB-A + 2x USB-C) is the console-wide count per ETC's datasheet; the split between front-panel and rear-panel USB ports is not detailed in the source, so individual ports are not labeled front/rear. Power cable is "locking regionalized" (Edison/Schuko-UK13A/Australasian variants depending on order code) — the console-side inlet itself is a standard IEC C13/14, which is what was recorded. Region/variant SKUs (-US/-EU/-AZ) and output-count tiers (1K/5K/6K) do not change the physical I/O.

ports.name: DMX 1
ports.note: DMX-512/RDM port, 5-pin XLR. Console primarily outputs DMX; RDM adds bidirectional device-management data on the same line.

ports.name: USB-A 1
ports.note: Spec states 'USB 3.1' without a Gen1/Gen2 qualifier; grade assumed as USB 3.1 Gen 1 (5Gbps).

ports.name: Display Out 1
ports.note: Drives an external monitor, up to 3840x2160; ships with 2x active DisplayPort-to-DVI adapters. ETC does not state a DP version (1.2/1.4/2.0), so grade is omitted; full-size DisplayPort connector assumed (not explicitly confirmed as full-size vs mini-DP in source docs).

ports.name: Remote Trigger
ports.note: Actual connector is a 15-pin D-Sub wired for dry contact-closure triggers (Go/Pause/Go Back inputs) plus a +12V/status output — not an RS-232 serial interface. Mapped to 'rs232' as the closest connector shape available in the allowed connector list.

ports.name: Lamp (Littlite)
ports.note: 3-pin XLR wired as a 12VDC / 1W max power output for an accessory Littlite gooseneck lamp (pin1 chassis ground, pin2 0V, pin3 +12V) — a power connector, not an audio/DMX signal path.
